escalation_results.query_text: How much is the non-return fee if I don't send back my swapped device — is it $200?

envelope.answer: Yes, if you fail to return your damaged device within 10 business days, a non-return fee of up to $200 will be charged to your account. You must use the prepaid return label included in your swap package to avoid this fee.

escalation_results.query_text: My handset took a dip in the toilet — will my protection plan cover the repair?

envelope.answer: Yes, your protection plan covers accidental liquid immersion, including drops in toilets. To ensure your claim is processed, do not charge the device, keep it in a dry environment, and file your claim within 48 hours.

escalation_results.query_text: We're moving our company to a new telecom provider and need to keep our existing contact numbers.

envelope.answer: To port your existing numbers to our network, you must submit a Port Authorization Code (PAC) or account transfer PIN from your current carrier. You can manage this process via the 'Number Management' section in the admin portal, where you may port up to 100 numbers simultaneously. Please note that standard porting takes 5–7 business days, and you should confirm with your previous carrier that porting is permitted under your contract.

escalation_results.query_text: How do I add insurance to devices on my account?

envelope.answer: To add insurance, log in to your account portal and navigate to the "Insurance & Protection" section or the "Insurance" section to enroll your devices. If you are an SMB account holder, you can enroll devices in bulk through the admin portal. Please note that enrollment is generally restricted to within 30 days of purchase or during the annual open enrollment period in October.

escalation_results.query_text: What happens when I switch to a different plan mid-month?

envelope.answer: Plan changes take effect at the start of the next billing cycle. The provided documents do not contain further information regarding how switching plans mid-month affects your current billing or usage.

Deductible amounts vary by plan tier, ranging from $0 to $99 depending on your specific plan and device category. These fees are charged per approved claim and must be paid via credit card or account credit at the time of approval. Please note that legacy plans from before 2022 may follow different schedules; you can check your specific policy for more details.

escalation_results.query_text: And how long does that usually take?

envelope.answer: Shipping for a device swap typically takes 3–5 business days via standard delivery or 1–2 days with expedited shipping. If you are referring to the SMB account setup process, that typically takes 30–60 minutes for accounts with fewer than 10 lines.

escalation_results.query_text: I want to file a claim for my broken screen.

envelope.answer: To file a claim for your broken screen, log in to your account at my.carrier.com, navigate to 'Insurance & Protection,' and select 'File a Claim.' You will need your device’s IMEI number, the incident date, and a description of the damage. Alternatively, you can initiate the process by calling 1-800-555-0147.

escalation_results.query_text: How do I give one of my employees access to manage the company's phone account?

envelope.answer: To grant an employee access to manage your account, you should use the Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) features within the admin portal at business.carrier.com/portal. As the primary account holder, you can create sub-administrator accounts with specific permissions by navigating to the "User Management > Admin Accounts" section.
